dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Concave trailing edge exhibiting a low-degree parabolic curvature from the dorsal ridge to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded apex classification with a pixel radius of approximately 8-10 pixels relative to the fin height.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Anterior margin displays an angular steepness of approximately 50 degrees relative to the horizontal dorsal axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1.3:1 ratio of maximum base width to maximum vertical pixel height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Smoothly convex melon arc with a moderate radius relative to total cranial length.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short and blunt rostrum with a length-to-thickness ratio of approximately 1:1 extending from the inflection point.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle of approximately 145 degrees at the melon-rostrum junction.

other_distinctive_markers: Artificial cyan/teal monochromatic pigmentation and low-polygon mesh rendering artifacts.
